gp.message:
================================================================================
AFTER EFFECTS TÂNA FLEX GUI PRO - ENG NGE A THAR
Version 9.2.9  -  October 2026
================================================================================

Demon Slayer theme-te bakah ANIME THEME thar 33 a lo awm a, theme-te mouse effect chu
After Effects-ah a lang dik tak tawh a, Theme Selector pawh dropdown fel tak pakhat a ni tawh.

INTAN HMAIN
- I ZXP installer hman ṭhin hmangin i version tûn lai chungah install la, tichuan
  After Effects hi vawi khat restart rawh.
- I settings, theme, preset leh save expression-te chu a awm reng ang.

A THAR: ANIME THEME 33
- Flex Settings > THEME SELECTOR > PANEL THEME-ah hian anime tin tân group pakhat theuh a awm tawh:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) leh Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Character tinin an hmel bik an nei: i mouse zuitu, button i click
  hunah a beihna, left button i vawn reng laia thil thleng, leh
  second 2.5 vel i vawn hnua a puakna.
- Demon Slayer theme-te ang bawkin a rit lo: effect-te chu mouse i sawn emaw
  i click chhung chauhin an kal. Rawng chauh vawn nan AMBIENT EFFECT chu off rawh.

DANGLAM: THEME SELECTOR
- PANEL THEME hnuaia Demon Slayer card-te chu a bo ta a, chuvangin Flex Settings a
  tawi ta. Theme tin PANEL THEME dropdown atangin thlang rawh; a hawn hian i theme hman
  mek chu a lantir nghal ang.
- Kurama leh Baryon chu Naruto group-ah an awm tawh.

SIAM ṬHAT NIH
- Theme-te mouse effect (tui, mei, kaikuang leh a dang) hi Optimised Mode off a nih
  pawhin After Effects-ah a lang lo fo ṭhin. Panel ngei a buai lai leh a ṭan
  laia a buai lai chu theme a muang (lag) niin an ngai a, chuvangin
  effect-te chu mahni-in an inti-off ṭhin. Tunah chuan, i graphics card-in a draw chuan
  (computer tam berah), chung hun-ah chuan effect-te chu rei lo te chhung chauh an zangkhai deuh ang.

DANGLAM LOH
- Licensing, activation leh link tin chu a hmasa angin an thawk reng.
- Demon Slayer theme 11-te chu 9.2.8-a ang tak hian an lang.
- Tab dang leh tool dang zawng zawng chu 9.2.8-a ang tak hian an thawk.
================================================================================

- Demon Slayer theme 11-te chu 2.2.8-a ang tak hian an lang.
